coordinate_system: Original Blender rig, meters, Z up/front -Y. Runtime converts [x,y,z] to [x,z,-y].
source_frames: Declare the native frame origin per asset. Blender Studio frames1..151 and MPFB frames0..150 both map to runtime0..150 at30fps (five seconds).

clip.json.interpretation: Explicit authored staging choices, source limits and relevant display notes.
clip.json.skinning: linear or dualQuaternion; omitted means linear

cameras.json: Exactly2 objects {label,position:[x,y,z],target:[x,y,z],scale,frameSourceIds?}. Scale is orthographic horizontal width. Keep a whole-body companion throughout the clip. Detail IDs are unique integers0..sourceVertices-1 in the actual exported body domain; retain the complete model and verify its selected framing region.
pose-samples.json: Array of{id,frame,joints:{<bone-name>:[x,y,z]}} in BlenderZup coordinates at runtime0..150. Include all51 native bones for Blender Studio assets, or all clip-specific standard-GLB deformation groups/common root for MPFB. Reference native joint matrices explicitly; retain start, intermediate, hold and return states.
runtime-surface-reference.json: Source-domain support patches at sampled frames, checked in the actual GPU renderer. The reference_kind declares native or standard-linear CPU origin; do not infer native Bbone surface parity from a CPU transport reference.
notes: Values are schema examples, not literal measurements. Record actual deformed-skin minima and a separate floor plane. Blender Studio assets preserve their original Basis/rest/UV/sourceIDs and51bones, with diagnosed local binding/correctives declared. An MPFB replacement declares its seated bind, actual vertex/joint counts, source-ID and generated-cap provenance, native-control reference, normalized runtime grouped weights and every local POSITION/NORMAL corrective. Native Smooth/Multires/Bbone previews do not prove standard linear or DQ runtime appearance. Verify complete arms as well as hands when contact-critical. Stretch demonstrations use2senter/1shold/2sreturn and retain source20–30s workout holds; air bike0003 is a five-second alternating cycle.
dq-reference.json.gz: For DQ assets only: {source_sha256,source_vertices:10582,samples:[{id,frame,positions:[[x,y,z],...]}]}; all original IDs in order, at frames 0/30/75/120/150 with only Armature enabled. Include current pose-corrective influences.
source.blend: Editable authoring reference. For4512 this is the native kinematic action only; final standard-linear geometry, weights and contact targets are explicit runtime inputs declared in clip.json.
